newsitem.title: THAILAND: Thai bourse suspends trade in Capetronic.
newsitem.headline: Thai bourse suspends trade in Capetronic.

text.p: The Stock Exchange of Thailand said on Thursday it suspended trading in shares of Capetronic International (Thailand) Plc as the company plans to release a rehabilitation plan to investors and analysts later in the day.
The exchange said it suspended trading in Capetronic to give investors more time to consider the company's rehabilitation plan.
The company said in a separate statement to the exchange it planned to raise capital by issuing 15.8 million shares to raise 158 million baht ($6.32 million) and 63 million units of warrants.
Capetronic closed up 0.10 baht to 3.70 on Wednesday. ($1.00=25 baht)
